title: Prompt Engineering Utilities
summary: This module provides utilities for advanced prompt engineering, including generating few-shot examples and constructing structured queries from natural language. It also features a dedicated output parser for structured query formats.

nodes.label: Generate Few-Shot Example
nodes.title: Generate Few-Shot Example
nodes.description: Creates a new example string for few-shot prompting by combining existing examples with a prompt template and an LLM to produce relevant output.

nodes.label: Load Query Constructor Chain
nodes.title: Load Query Constructor Chain
nodes.description: Initializes an LLMChain designed to translate natural language into structured queries, considering document attributes, allowed operations, and an optional schema prompt.

nodes.label: Structured Query Output Parser
nodes.title: Structured Query Output Parser
nodes.description: Parses raw text output, typically in JSON markdown, into a structured query object, validating against defined comparators, operators, and attributes for robust query construction.

nodes.label: Large Language Model
nodes.title: Large Language Model (LLM)
nodes.description: Provides the core AI capabilities for text generation, understanding, and prompt completion, essential for both example generation and query construction.

nodes.label: Prompt Template
nodes.title: Prompt Template Definition
nodes.description: Defines the structure and content for prompts, guiding the LLM's output format and context for various tasks like example generation or query schema definition.

nodes.label: Few-Shot Examples Data
nodes.title: Few-Shot Examples Data
nodes.description: A collection of input-output pairs that serve as demonstrations to guide the LLM in generating new, similar examples for improved prompt performance.

nodes.label: Document Attribute Information
nodes.title: Document Attribute Information
nodes.description: Metadata describing the fields, types, and constraints of attributes within documents, used to inform and validate structured query generation.

nodes.label: Structured Query Object
nodes.title: Structured Query Object
nodes.description: The final, parsed representation of a query, typically including a query string, filter directives, and optional limits, ready for execution against a data source.

groups.label: Prompt Engineering Tools
groups.title: Core Prompt Engineering Tools
groups.description: Components responsible for generating prompts, examples, or entire chains to facilitate advanced prompt engineering techniques.

groups.label: Output Processing
groups.title: Structured Output Processing
groups.description: Handles the parsing and validation of LLM-generated text into structured data formats, ensuring correctness and usability.

groups.label: Inputs & Configuration
groups.title: Data Inputs and Configuration
groups.description: External data sources and configuration elements that drive the behavior and content of the prompt engineering components.

groups.label: External Systems
groups.title: External AI Systems
groups.description: Represents external Large Language Models that provide the underlying intelligence for text generation and understanding.

groups.label: Outputs
groups.title: Module Outputs
groups.description: The primary structured data output generated by the module's components.
